name: Phoenix 2025 Water Quality Report
known_limitations: The report covers the Phoenix public drinking-water system and 2025 detected substances and compliance measures. It does not establish industrial water availability, facility demand, wastewater acceptance, reuse capacity, or site-level hydraulic conditions.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Water Services Department
automation_notes: Capture the next annual report and retain the boundary between regulated drinking-water quality and industrial service capacity.
